evidence.detail: SIDEBOARD_WEIGHT = 0.2 means sideboard-only cards (companions like Yorion) are counted at 20% weight vs maindeck plays
interesting() uses playability thresholds of 0.01 and 0.1; a companion in 20% of sideboards gets playability ~0.04, below 'heavily-played' threshold

triage.notes: The /rotation/changes page itself (rotationchanges.mustache) does not currently show 'interesting' markers at all — those only appear on /rotation/speculation. The issue is whether interesting() should use a different metric for companion/sideboard-heavy cards. Requires deciding on a new threshold or a sideboard-aware heuristic.
